_source: wube/factorio-data 2.1.20 prototypes (crafting_speed, crafting_categories, module_slots, base_effect). Belt/inserter figures are game-wiki throughput values.
_crafter_notes: Space Age adds extra categories to many base recipes (e.g. belts -> metallurgy, modules -> electromagnetics). Check a recipe's 'categories' list against a machine's list; any overlap means that machine can craft it. Some SA machines also accept extra base categories via base-data-updates (e.g. EM plant can do electronics 'crafting' recipes that list 'electromagnetics').
_drill_notes: items/s per drill = speed * (1 + speed_bonus) * (1 + mining_productivity) / mining_time. mining_time: iron/copper/coal/stone/tungsten = 1, uranium-ore = 2 (needs 1 sulfuric acid per ore... 10 per 10). Electric drill on iron = 0.5/s.
_belt_notes: items_per_s is for both lanes together; each lane carries half. underground_max_gap = number of tiles that may lie BETWEEN entrance and exit (max_distance - 1). Stacked belts (Space Age, Gleba/Fulgora research) multiply throughput up to 4x but only bulk/stack inserters stack.

bulk-inserter.note: multiplied by hand size (up to 12 with research); best for chest->chest or machine output

_inserter_notes: Throughput from belts is lower than chest-to-chest and rises with inserter capacity bonus research. Rule of thumb: one fast inserter (no bonuses) moves ~2.3 items/s; a yellow inserter ~0.83/s. Count needed inserters per machine = machine's item rate / per-inserter rate, rounded up.

big-electric-pole.note: supply 2 = basically only itself; use for transmission

_pole_notes: supply = half-width of the square supply area measured from pole centre (small pole powers a 5x5 square). A machine is powered if any tile of its footprint overlaps that square. reach = max wire distance between pole centres.
_module_notes: 2.0: beacon distribution efficiency 1.5 and a diminishing factor 1/sqrt(n_beacons) affecting a machine. Productivity modules only work on recipes with allow_productivity=true (intermediates). Speed and consumption floors: speed >= -80%.
